name: Banner
description: A banner is a support artifact that places a circle on the ground, granting strength to heroes that walk inside it.

name: Blaze Bangle
description: A blaze bangle is an artifact that adds a status to the hero that causes their weapons to apply burning.

name: Blight Bangle
description: A blight bangle is an artifact that adds a status to the hero that causes their weapons to apply poison.

name: Cinder Scepter
description: A cinder scepter is an fiery artifact that summons fire around enemies.

name: Conductive Quiver
description: A conductive quiver is an artifact that loads three electric arrows into the hero's ranged weapon.

name: Corrupted Beacon
description: A corrupted beacon is an offensive artifact that fires a damaging purple beam when active.

name: Corrupted Seeds
description: Corrupted seeds are an artifact that places sprouts vines, inflicting poison on mobs within them.

name: Creeper Candle
description: A creeper candle is an artifact that places an explosive candle on the ground, exploding shortly after.

name: Death Cap Mushroom
description: A death cap mushroom is an artifact that grants increased movement and attack speed.

name: Electric Bangle
description: An electric bangle is an artifact that applies a status to the hero that causes their weapons to deal electric damage.

name: Ender Fog
description: Ender fog is an artifact that adds the shadowcloaking status to the hero when used.

name: Fighter's Flute
description: A fighter's flute is an artifact that grants a status which greatly increases the chance of critical hits.

name: Firework Arrow
description: A firework arrow is an offensive artifact that loads an explosive firework into your ranged weapon.

name: Flaming Quiver
description: A flaming quiver is an artifact that loads three flaming arrows into the hero's ranged weapon.

name: Freezing Quiver
description: A freezing quiver is an artifact that loads three icy arrows into the hero's ranged weapon.

name: Grindstone
description: A grindstone is an artifact.

name: Soul Harvester
description: A soul harvester is an artifact that releases a burst of souls, dealing damage in a large radius.

name: Honey Dipper
description: A honey dipper is an artifact that drops honey and bees on the ground.

name: Lightning Rod
description: A lightning rod is an electric artifact that summons lightning around enemies.

name: Picnic Basket
description: A picnic basket is a supportive artifact that summons food when placed.

name: Pouch of Fire
description: A pouch of fire is a fiery artifact that releases an explosive burst of fire.

name: Pouch of Thunder
description: A pouch of thunder is an electric artifact that releases an explosive burst of lightning.

name: Powershaker
description: A powershaker is an artifact that imbues the user with a status causing their attacks to release explosions on mobs.

name: Redstone Mine Launcher
description: A redstone mine launcher is an artifact that deploys redstone mines on the ground which explode after a short delay.

name: Tempo Truffle
description: A tempo truffle is an artifact that grants the hero a movement speed boost.

name: Totem of Casting
description: A totem of casting is an artifact that places an area of effect, granting heroes within it reduced artifact cooldown times.

name: Totem of Shielding
description: The totem of shielding is an artifact that, when placed, spawns a shield that protects against projectiles.

name: Turtle Master's Mandolin
description: The turtle master's mandolin is a musical artifact that provides a defensive boost to all nearby allies.

name: Venomous Quiver
description: A venomous quiver is an artifact that loads three poisonous arrows into the hero's ranged weapon.

name: Warding Chimes
description: Warding chimes are an artifact that make the hero temporarily impervious to damage.

name: Warrior Drums
description: Warrior drums are an artifact that grants the hero a status effect that increases critical hit damage for a few seconds.

name: Wind Horn
description: A wind horn is an artifact that blows a gust of wind.

name: Winter Staff
description: Frost attacks deal 15% more damage.

name: Witch Brew
description: A witch brew is a throwable artifact that creates a purple cloud where it lands.
